item.title: A weekend in the Dolomites
item.description: We left Cortina before dawn, with headlamps and a thermos of coffee. By the time the sun hit the Tre Cime, we were already above the clouds.
item.content:encoded:
We left Cortina before dawn, with headlamps and a thermos of coffee. By the time the sun hit the Tre Cime, we were already above the clouds.

The route

From Rifugio Auronzo to Locatelli, on to Pian di Cengia, then back down through Val Fiscalina. Start early: the trail is quiet until nine.

item.title: Hello, world
item.description: Welcome to your new site! This post was written on a phone with SiteDev.
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to your new site! This post was written on a phone with SiteDev.

Writing

Use the toolbar for bold, italic, links and images. The Front matter button at the top opens the title, tags, date and draft.

Publishing

Tap Deploy: SiteDev builds the site, shows exactly which files will be uploaded, changed or deleted, and sends only those. Offline? The deploy waits in a queue until the connection is back.

Shortcodes

A few Hugo-style shortcodes work, for example {{< youtube VIDEO_ID >}}. See Engine docs in the menu.
